result.title: Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
result.summary: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-ν_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises $G$ in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises $G$ in all 52 ($p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$ over 13 memory-encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest $G$ of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究 AI agent 记忆嵌入向量的压缩保真度，用无标签的局部保真度（10 近邻）与全局保真度（30–50% 记忆范围）共同评价，并据此提出面向 OPQ 码本的 locality-aware quantization（LAQ），把远端的秩违规率界转化为码本训练目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“近邻保真”与“远端结构保真”分离的表示几何评价，以及由界导出的量化目标，可能为 LVR 中压缩后的 latent 状态或缓存是否仍保留足够区分度提供可核查的度量与训练线索，但该文不涉及视觉证据或多模态推理。
